title: LTEM: LLM-Friendly Table-Enhanced Markdown for Table Understanding and Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.29188v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tables in real-world documents, including scientific papers, financial reports, and statistical summaries, frequently use merged cells, multi-level headers, and sectioned layouts. Yet the lightweight formats LLMs handle best (Markdown, CSV) cannot express these structures, while expressive formats (HTML, LaTeX) impose excessive token cost and parsing complexity. To enable systematic analysis of this trade-off, we introduce a taxonomy decomposing table structure into six atomic features (F1-F6) and corresponding complexity levels (L1-L6), and construct STB (Synthetic Table Benchmark), a controlled benchmark with 1,089 tables systematically distributed across complexity levels. Using this framework, we propose LTEM (LLM-friendly Table-Enhanced Markdown), a formally specified, minimal extension of Markdown that explicitly encodes spans and hierarchical headers. translated_title: LTEM：面向表格理解与生成的LLM友好型表格增强Markdown格式
translated_abstract: 现实世界文档中的表格，包括科学论文、财务报告和统计摘要，经常使用合并单元格、多级表头和分区布局。然而，大语言模型最擅长处理的轻量级格式（Markdown、CSV）无法表达这些结构，而表达力强的格式（HTML、LaTeX）则带来过高的token成本和解析复杂性。为了系统分析这种权衡，我们引入了一种分类法，将表格结构分解为六个原子特征（F1-F6）和相应的复杂度级别（L1-L6），并构建了STB（合成表格基准），这是一个包含1,089个表格的受控基准，这些表格系统地分布在各复杂度级别上。利用该框架，我们提出了LTEM（LLM友好的表格增强Markdown），这是一种形式化定义的Markdown最小扩展，显式编码单元格跨度和层级表头。在五个最先进的大语言模型上的实验表明，LTEM实现了准确率的……
tldr: 该论文提出LTEM——一种LLM友好的Markdown最小扩展格式，通过显式编码单元格跨度和层级表头来表达复杂表格结构，在保持轻量级token成本的同时，显著提升了大语言模型对真实文档中复杂表格的理解与生成准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LTEM, an LLM-friendly, formally specified minimal extension of Markdown that explicitly encodes cell spans and hierarchical headers, enabling large language models to understand and generate complex real-world tables while maintaining lightweight token efficiency.
